critical_observations.ground_truth_advisory: This recording captures the application UI rendering prior predictions. Interface overlays, sample predictions, and bounding box coordinates are not ground truth and must not be used for model training.
critical_observations.food_waste_status: Food waste is completely unrepresented in this recording. A dedicated independent food waste dataset and test split must be constructed.
critical_observations.duplication_issue: Repeated video sequences (10-15s) generated redundant event logs due to lack of temporal object tracking across adjacent frames.
critical_observations.warning_sign_false_positive: A yellow wet-floor caution sign placed on dry tiles triggered a critical spill alarm, indicating severe context bias rather than genuine fluid feature recognition.

scene_breakdown.visible_condition: Tangled black and grey electrical power cables lying across light floor tiles near pedestrian feet.
scene_breakdown.localization_quality: Deficient - Oversized box spanning 65% of screen height including normal tile floor and person shoes.
scene_breakdown.mitigation_required: Tighten bounding box coordinates around the actual cable bundle using fine-grained polygon/box annotations.

scene_breakdown.visible_condition: Stacked cardboard boxes and shipping parcels obstructing an aisle walkway.
scene_breakdown.localization_quality: Moderate - Box coordinates included empty side aisle areas.
scene_breakdown.mitigation_required: Isolate actual footprint of boxes and debris from walkable floor space.

scene_breakdown.visible_condition: Overturned plastic beverage bottle with transparent liquid puddle spreading across white ceramic tiles.
scene_breakdown.localization_quality: Grossly Inaccurate - Liquid boundary omitted, bottle misclassified into floor mat or single giant box.
scene_breakdown.mitigation_required: Disentangle the bottle (trash_litter) from the spread liquid puddle (water_spill) with dedicated multi-box localization.

scene_breakdown.visible_condition: Cracked and chipped industrial concrete floor slab.
scene_breakdown.mitigation_required: Consolidate structural floor trip hazards into obstacle_debris or handle as surface defect with clear severity rating.

scene_breakdown.visible_condition: Raised, curled transition lip of commercial floor runner mat.
scene_breakdown.localization_quality: Acceptable localization of mat edge, but non-canonical classification.
scene_breakdown.mitigation_required: Map curled runner edges to canonical obstacle_debris trip hazard.

scene_breakdown.visible_condition: High-visibility yellow 'Wet Floor' caution cone placed in warehouse walkway; pedestrian walking in background; floor is clean and dry.
scene_breakdown.localization_quality: Severe False Positive - Warning sign classified as active water spill.
scene_breakdown.mitigation_required: Incorporate hard-negative training images of caution signs, safety cones, and walking people on dry floors without liquid spills.

scene_breakdown.visible_condition: Loop of earlier scenes playing in web application interface.
scene_breakdown.prior_predicted_class: Generated duplicate events for identical hazards
scene_breakdown.mitigation_required: Implement IoU / ByteTrack object persistence and event consolidation to unify multiple frames into single hazard events with first_seen, last_seen, and peak_confidence.

food_waste_deficiency_remedy.action: Construct independent diverse food-waste dataset across diverse floor substrates (white tile, dark marble, hardwood, concrete) covering rice, bread crumbs, vegetable trimmings, fruit peels, sauces, and dropped meals.
food_waste_deficiency_remedy.localization_rule: Bounding boxes must tightly encircle food fragments, excluding surrounding non-soiled floor, plates, bowls, and clean packaging.
